reviewerOrPass: Worker A, same AI, separate source-first final pass
independenceMethod: The same AI separately reopened and hash-checked the adopted regulations and exact course sources, reconstructed the annual credit structure and entry rules, and reconsidered workbook courses and distinctions before reading the frozen display record.
findings: The adopted chart has 60 EC per year, including one restricted elective per spring period in year two and a 30 EC exchange in year three. It requires an individual specialisation thesis, with academic and methods entry, registration and supervision. The English requirement is attached to Academic Skills in the adopted regulations, with different wording in the Study Guide. Both research participation requirements gate award of credits. The UCR management option includes empirical market work and broad business study. The responsibility option links accounting, policy and finance to life-cycle analysis, climate and governance and gains econometric methods. The consumer option builds on market research, product design, social psychology and behavioural economics. These remain distinct by six, seven and eleven courses pairwise. The selected descriptions and pairings support partial links. The record distinguishes enterprise systems, logistics, exchange and the supervised thesis. The optional research reference sits outside the 180 EC schedule.
